patch_description: The current candidate added a "mid-circuit RY refresh layer" on qubits 0,2,3,7 which increased the parameter count (162→186) and circuit depth (41→47), but *decreased* combined score from 0.63 to 0.60 along with worse validation accuracy (0.72→0.68) and test accuracy (0.65→0.63). This strongly suggests the extra mid-layer adds noise/overfitting risk without benefit given the fixed training budget. Reverting to the leaner seed structure (no mid-layer) restores the better-performing configuration, while keeping the well-tested CRZ entangling structure intact. This also aligns with the recommendation to keep depth lean; removing the mid-layer directly reduces depth by ~4-6 layers and drops 24 unnecessary parameters, improving parameter efficiency without touching the entangling topology that was already shown to generalize better.
